name: issue_1208_return_home_warm_day_restores_comfort
description: Issue #1208 (fixed): warm day (classifier derives hvac_mode=off, comfort band armed). The occupant leaves and the away setback is held through two classification cycles; on returning at 14:00 the comfort ceiling (75F) is restored on arrival, not up to 30 minutes later when the next classification cycle runs.
notes: Regression scenario for Issue #1208 (fixed, owner-approved for golden 2026-11-02): before the fix the 'off' label made the arrival restore a no-op and the 80F away ceiling stayed until the next 30-minute cycle.
Occupant outcome: the occupant comes home on a warm afternoon and the thermostat gets the 75F comfort ceiling at once.
Before Issue #85, apply_classification() would overwrite away setback with comfort temps every 30 minutes; the 10:00/10:30 setback assertions still verify that fix.

(a) Scenario effectiveness: with the band-derived mode in _set_temperature_for_mode / the arrival family reverted, the 14:00 comfort_restored assertion fails (setback stays); this scenario reported EXPECTED FAIL on main before the fix.

(b) Docs <-> production: docs/08-COMPUTATION-REFERENCE.md (E10, comfort restore on off days) and docs/occupancy-dispatch-spec.md step 3 describe the band-derived restore implemented in the same change.
(c) User outcome if this regresses: on warm days the occupant returns to a house held at the away setback for up to 30 minutes while the push says comfort is being restored.

Mild-day (heat family) sibling: issue_1208_return_home_mild_day_restores_comfort. Both fan modes, the door-close / nat-vent / economizer / resume mirrors and the Rule 3 blower hold are covered by tests/test_return_home_off_day_1208.py and tests_ha/test_return_home_off_day_1208.py.

events.note: morning classification — cool mode at 75F comfort
user leaves home — should apply cool setback (80F) after delay
30-min classification cycle fires while away — must NOT overwrite setback with comfort
another classification cycle — should still maintain setback

assertions.reason: initial classification at home — cool mode applied (comfort_cool=75F)
classification while away — setback reapplied (80F), comfort NOT restored
another classification while away — setback maintained (80F)
Issue #1208: by the 14:30 classification cycle the occupant is home, so the armed comfort band ceiling must equal comfort_cool (75F), not the 80F away setback.

verdict.summary: Issue #1208: returning home on a warm day restores the comfort ceiling on arrival
verdict.observed_behavior: comfort_restored (75F) at 14:00; armed band ceiling 75F at 14:30
verdict.expected_behavior: comfort_restored (75F) at 14:00, and the comfort band ceiling equals comfort_cool (75F) at 14:30
